boundary: Only newly created profiles use issuance version 2. Missing issuanceVersion decodes as legacy version 1; explicit null and malformed version-2 metadata fail closed. Valid existing, imported and migrated profiles keep their exact seed and catalog mapping. Legacy high-bit or colliding seeds require one-time repair that preserves the hardware-tuple residue. The four tuple set is a reviewed product policy, not a claim of market prevalence, anonymity, a shared full-fingerprint cohort or third-party acceptance.
